title: WatchBox Service Record Weekly Turnaround Days Trend
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watchbox:service turnaround_days=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(turnaround_days) as avg_duration, max(turnaround_days) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst turnaround days for WatchBox service record events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture turnaround_days on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average turnaround days with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether WatchBox service record tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
